---
title: "Analyzing School District Reading Scores"
Author: "Avalee Lenard"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = "data/seda_2025.duckdb", read_only = TRUE)
dbplyr_dist <- tbl(con, "district_scores")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| cache.extra: !expr file.mtime("data/seda_2025.duckdb")
score_change <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year %in% c(2015, 2023), !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, year, rla_score) |>
  collect() |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = rla_score, names_prefix = "year_") |>
  filter(!is.na(year_2015), !is.na(year_2023)) |>
  mutate(score_change = year_2023 - year_2015) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, score_change)

state_change <- tbl(con, "state_scores") |>
  filter(year %in% c(2015, 2023), !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, year, rla_score) |>
  collect() |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = rla_score, names_prefix = "year_") |>
  filter(!is.na(year_2015), !is.na(year_2023)) |>
  mutate(score_change = year_2023 - year_2015) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, year_2015, year_2023, score_change)

dbDisconnect(con)
```

```{r}
score_change |>
  rename(rla_change = score_change) |>
  mutate(change_type = case_when(
    rla_change > 0 ~ "Positive",
    rla_change < 0 ~ "Negative",
    TRUE ~ "No change"
  )) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = rla_change, fill = change_type)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of District Reading Score Changes",
    subtitle = paste("District count:", scales::comma(nrow(score_change))),
    x = "Change in reading score (2023 minus 2015)",
    y = "Number of districts",
    fill = "Change",
    caption = "Positive values indicate improvement; only districts with scores in both years are included."
  )
```

```{r}
state_change |>
  mutate(
    change_type = case_when(
      score_change > 0 ~ "Positive",
      score_change < 0 ~ "Negative",
      TRUE ~ "No change"
    ),
    state_name = fct_reorder(state_name, year_2023)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = state_name, color = change_type)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = year_2015, xend = year_2023, yend = state_name),
    arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(0.12, "inches"), type = "closed")
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = year_2015), color = "gray60") +
  labs(
    title = "State Reading Scores: 2015 to 2023",
    subtitle = "Arrows show each state's change in reading score",
    x = "Reading score",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Change",
    caption = "Gray dots mark 2015 scores; arrowheads mark 2023 scores."
  )
```
